# dsh-pinned-sessions

> npm package: **`@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions`** · repo: `dsh-pinned-sessions`

der with an **outline** pin glyph, a count and

every pinned session, across

## What it does

DSH already pins sessions (hover a row → pin glyph, or right-click → 「置顶会话」),
but the result is only

a re-order **inside that session's own workspace group**: a
pinned session still scrolls away when

you switch workspaces, collapse groups, or
drown in a long list.
This plugin gives the pinned set its own group, above the Workspace browser:

## How it is mounted

The sidebar's browsing region between the global panel rows and the foot is
declared as **one `singl

e` slot** (`sidebar.workspaces`) owned by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`, and it exposes no

.workspaces`) owned by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`, and it exposes no "extra group" seat:
| seat | owner | what it holds |
| `sidebar.panellist` (list) | ui-sidebar | the global panel rows (插件, 自动化任务, …) — a row is a button

, not a group |
| `sidebar.workspaces` (single) | ui-workspace | the whole browsing region: header,
search, tree, menus |

Shadowing `sidebar.workspaces` would mean reimplementing the entire browser
(search, flat/grouped vi

ews, drag ordering, menus, hover cards, archive flow), so
instead this plugin mounts **next to the r

enderer's own outlet anchor**
(`div[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]`, `display: contents`) as its pr

evious
sibling inside the region, and portals the group into that host node:

- nothing is ever inserted into the native component's DOM subtree;
- the host node is `flex: none`,

so the native browser keeps `flex: 1` and simply
gets a little less height — the pinned group stays

put while the list scrolls;
- the anchor is re-resolved through a throttled `MutationObserver`, so

DSH changes the sidebar), the plugin
renders nothing instead of breaking anything.

## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The package is dual-face (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`): the Loader row
brings up the no-op Hos

t half, and the browser half arrives through
`exports["./client"]`.
### Local development (this checkout)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then **reload the Web UI** (⌘R / F5). The boot graph is rebuilt per page load, so
an edited `lib/cli

ent.js` shows up on the next reload — no application restart.
Do **not** also add `@vfvrpq/dsh-pinne

d-sessions` to `dsh.profile.bundles` at the
same time: `insert` is append-only and never de-duplicat

es ids, so the plugin
would be mounted twice and its slot registrations would collide. (Appending th

at
row to a patch file that still holds the template's bare `[]` produces invalid
YAML and is silent
ly ignored — `[]` plus a sequence is two documents in one file.)
## Develop

`lib/client.js` is the browser bundle, written by hand in the same
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ i

d, factory })` shape the build emits — plain JS
with `react.createElement`, no build step, no JSX. `

apply(ctx)` registers exactly
one entry:
| registration | slot | id |
| sidebar group (portals into the sidebar) | `shell.overlay` (list) | `pinned-sessions-section` |

Client services it injects: `slots`, `sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`,
`uiSession`, `locale`.

It reads the three stores (`sessions.list`,
`workspaces.list`, `uiSession.sessionStatus`) through `

useSyncExternalStore` and
never writes to them directly.

The scheduled-task clock does **not** go through a slot: the
`sidebar.session.row.leading` seat is d

eclared by ui-workspace's entry, the slot
runtime rejects a `renderSlot` the caller did not declare,

and declaring an
already-declared seat throws `slot "…" is already declared`. So the group reads th

e
same Host catalog (`schedule/catalog()`) itself — one read for the whole group,
refreshed on `sche

dule/changed` and connection reset, released when the last row
unmounts. `remote` is deliberately **

not** a required inject: a composition without
ui-schedule still loads the group, it just has no clo

** a required inject: a composition without
ui-schedule still loads the group, it just has no clock.
